name: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep
description: Iconic hilltop temple overlooking the city, reached by a 306-step naga staircase or a funicular.

name: Wat Phra Singh
description: Revered temple in the Old City housing the Phra Singh Buddha image, classic Lanna architecture.

name: Wat Chedi Luang
description: Massive 14th-century pagoda ruins in the heart of the Old City.

name: Sunday Walking Street (Ratchadamnoen Road)
description: Weekly night market through the Old City with local crafts, street food, and live music.

name: Chiang Mai Night Bazaar
description: Long-running nightly market on Chang Klan Road with souvenirs, clothes, and food stalls.

name: Warorot Market (Kad Luang)
description: Chiang Mai's oldest and largest local market for produce, snacks, textiles, and street food.

name: Elephant Nature Park
description: Ethical elephant sanctuary where visitors observe and feed rescued elephants (no riding).

name: Doi Inthanon National Park
description: Thailand's highest peak, with waterfalls, cloud forest trails, and the twin royal pagodas.

name: Huay Tung Tao Lake
description: Relaxed lakeside spot at the foot of Doi Suthep with bamboo huts and lakeside food vendors.

name: Chiang Mai Old City Moat Loop
description: Walk or cycle the square moat surrounding the historic Old City, passing gates and corner temples.

name: Chiang Mai Zoo
description: Large hillside zoo including a panda exhibit and a walkable aquarium.

name: Chiang Mai National Museum
description: Overview of Lanna Kingdom history, Buddhist art, and northern Thai culture.

name: Ristr8to Original
description: Award-winning specialty coffee shop known for latte art, popular with digital nomads.

name: Graph Cafe (Nimman)
description: Minimalist cafe in trendy Nimmanhaemin known for Thai-style iced tea lattes.

name: Nimmanhaemin Road (Nimman)
description: Trendy district with boutique cafes, street art, galleries, and shopping malls.

name: Wat Umong
description: Forest temple with ancient brick tunnels and a peaceful woodland setting, less crowded.

name: Bua Thong Waterfalls (Sticky Falls)
description: Limestone waterfall you can climb barefoot thanks to its grippy mineral surface.

name: Chiang Mai Gate Food Stalls
description: Casual open-air street food stalls near the southern Old City gate, popular for dinner.
